description: Territoires à Risques Important d'Inondation (TRI) du Mans - Ouvrages de protection contre les inondations is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalogue.sigloire.fr. Geographical data set produced by the GIS Flooding Directive of the Land at Significant Flood Risk (TRI) of Le Mans and mapped for reporting purposes for the European Floods Directive. European Directive 2007/60/EC of 23 October 2007 on the assessment and management of flood risks (OJ L 288, 06-11-2007, p. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Land at Significant Flood Risk (TRI) of Le Mans - Flood protection works" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include territoire à risque d’inondation, surface inondable, directive inondation, risque, cartographie, RISQUE/N_INONDATION. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
